summary: Irish-born father of Anna Agnes Higgins according to family records; possibly John's 3rd-great-grandfather.
bio: William Higgins is named in family records, without documentation, as the father of Anna Agnes Higgins, with Mary Ann Reilly as her mother; if that is right he was John's 3rd-great-grandfather. He was born in Ireland, which agrees with the 1910 census entry for Anna, who gave her father's birthplace as Ireland and her mother's as Pennsylvania.
